captions.detailed: A professional photographer's beauty dish reflector mounted on an adjustable boom arm and tripod stand. The structure features a matte black tripod base with three thin legs extending from a central hub, supporting a tall vertical post. At the top of the post, a revolute joint connects a horizontal boom arm that can tilt and rotate. The end of the boom arm holds a large, shallow dome-shaped beauty dish with a light grey finish, attached via a tilting yoke joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a photographer's beauty dish on a boom stand. The assembly should include a three-legged tripod base supporting a tall vertical column, a horizontal boom arm connected via a dual-axis pivot at the top of the column, and a large shallow dome-shaped reflector dish mounted at the end of the boom arm with adjustable tilt capabilities.
captions.factory: Construct a tripod base using three thin cylinders rotated and translated symmetrically from a central cylindrical hub. Extrude a tall vertical cylinder to represent the main support post. Model the joint connector at the top of the post using box primitives. Create the horizontal boom arm as a long rectangular extrusion. For the beauty dish, use a revolved profile or a hollowed dome primitive to form the shallow reflector, and attach it to the boom arm with a U-shaped yoke bracket built from jointed box and cylinder parts.
